rules.statement: The conduct of the 1st respondent throughout the transaction was not dishonest and the allegations of misconduct, misbehaviour, and corruption were unfounded.
rules.supporting_quote: Per Samarakoon, C.J. (1) "I cannot see anything dishonest in his (1st respondent's) conduct throughout the transaction. I therefore hold that the allegations of misconduct (grave, or otherwise), misbehaviour and corruption, are unfounded and reject them. He has not compromised his position as a Judge of the Court of
